Summary: 10 requirements reviewed: 4 with issues, 6 without. 3 issues found (1 High, 1 Medium, 1 Low). Types: Vague_Language (1), Incomplete_Requirement (1), Internal_Contradiction (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of a successful payment.
REQ-002: The system shall apply free shipping to all orders with a subtotal of $50 or more.
REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
REQ-004: Managers and finance staff who have completed security training shall be able to approve refunds.
REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
REQ-006: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
REQ-007: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
REQ-009: The product search shall return results within 1.5 seconds for 98% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
REQ-010: Customer payment card numbers shall be stored in encrypted form.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The terms 'quickly' and 'large number' have no objective interpretation, so the requirement cannot be verified or implemented.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define specific load time targets and shopper capacity thresholds for the checkout page.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement specifies retention purpose but lacks a duration, so the retention period cannot be implemented or verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: State the retention duration for payment transaction records.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-006: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
IssuesIdentified.RelatedEvidence: REQ-007: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: REQ-006 and REQ-007 define conflicting cancellation conditions for orders, so both cannot be satisfied simultaneously.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Clarify the exact timing of order dispatch and payment confirmation to resolve the contradiction.
